column1: # Shaders to translate next (one key a line, in first-use order): after the fast setup's first batch (shader_first.tsv), the background translation
# (setup_game.py --rest) takes these before the rest, so the places a player reaches soon after the start (the Wild Area's ground, battles, towns) are
# ready early instead of drawing nothing until their batch comes (#173). Recorded on a Galaxy S25+ (Pokémon Shield 1.3.2): its pipeline list from many
# sessions, minus the first batch. Keys only (dm_ctl_sha16), as shader_map.tsv lists them: no shader code.
